clear.criterion: At screening, participants must be at least 18 years old and have an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
clear.protocol: Assess both age and performance status at the study screening encounter.

open.criterion: Participants must meet the study's ECOG performance status requirement at screening.
open.protocol: Measure ECOG performance status at the screening encounter. The supplied eligibility section gives no qualifying scores.

unmapped.criterion: At screening, participants must be at least 18 years old and have a serum albumin concentration of at least 3.0 g/dL.
unmapped.protocol: Use the serum albumin concentration from the screening encounter.

answered_narrow.criterion: Participants must meet the study's ECOG performance status requirement at screening.
answered_narrow.protocol: Measure ECOG performance status at the screening encounter. The supplied eligibility section gives no qualifying scores.
answered_narrow.question:Q1: Which ECOG performance status scores qualify a participant at the screening encounter?
answered_narrow.answer:Q1: At screening, only ECOG scores of 0 or 1 qualify.

answered_wide.criterion: Participants must meet the study's ECOG performance status requirement at screening.
answered_wide.protocol: Measure ECOG performance status at the screening encounter. The supplied eligibility section gives no qualifying scores.
answered_wide.question:Q1: Which ECOG performance status scores qualify a participant at the screening encounter?
answered_wide.answer:Q1: At screening, ECOG scores of 0, 1, or 2 qualify.

answered_unclear.criterion: Participants must meet the study's ECOG performance status requirement at screening.
answered_unclear.protocol: Measure ECOG performance status at the screening encounter. The supplied eligibility section gives no qualifying scores.
answered_unclear.question:Q1: Which ECOG performance status scores qualify a participant at the screening encounter?
answered_unclear.answer:Q1: The screening team should use the usual scores.

neok_age.protocol: NEOK001-1 Protocol Amendment 2, 26 June 2026. Section 5.1, inclusion criterion 2, page 49. Page 54: If at any time in the screening period a participant fails to meet the eligibility criteria, the participant will be designated a screen failure.

exclusion.criterion: ECOG performance status of 3 or higher.
exclusion.protocol: Use the ECOG score from the screening encounter.
